rules.evidence: Source contains numbered products and thin titles; this shared lexical check does not protect numeric identity and has not been measured on toys gold.

rules.description: Compare explicitly evidenced set/model identifiers without dropping numerals; a conflicting or missing identifier must block automatic placement on that numbered product.
rules.origin: observed Amazon building sets and RC titles

rules.description: Block automatic complete-toy or exact-variant placement for an accessory-only or assorted/random offer without explicit supporting evidence.
rules.origin: observed Amazon compatibility and assorted offers
rules.evidence: Display stands, replacement RC components and random colors occur in RAW; taxo.tools.toys.offering_evidence is implemented locally but requires shared check registration, candidate offering/variant fields and gold evaluation before enabling.

blockers: Shared domain/rule registration pending integration owner
No human gold or validated rules
Shared numeric lattice/brand heuristics require toys integration review
